name: simwal
algorithm: an append-and-sync write-ahead log on std.sim's simulated disk: one Sim, n records of 20 bytes each written at the log's end and synced, then a Restart and a read of the whole log (README.md).

skip.go: no std simulated Io (testing/fstest.MapFS is a read-only file tree with no crash model)

notes: Written by std-sim for SIM-R8 (status/std-sim.md): a sync touches only the pages written since the last one, so the row is linear in n. A row with no baseline: it tracks std.sim's own cost, and no ratio is published from it.
